user_review.method: Author context-aware CLI execution, deterministic failure/recovery tests, and explicitly labeled instruction simulations. No independent agent or human usability study.

scenarios.request: Check whether remembered context for an unfamiliar project is usable.
scenarios.expected: Read-only status, bounded current brief, staleness and pending work, without silent initialization.
scenarios.observed: Executed doctor on this task before initialization: exit 1 and not_initialized, with no database created. Explicitly initialized later for authorized ongoing work, captured the actual language correction, then doctor returned that sourced preference and the missing-checkpoint issue.

scenarios.request: An evidence file changed after capture.
scenarios.expected: Flag stale source, exclude it from execute context and leave source/store unmodified.
scenarios.observed: test_doctor changes a real fixture source and confirms stale status, empty current brief and untouched changed source. Fixed the macOS /var alias in the test fixture by resolving the selected root; did not weaken engine path checks.

scenarios.request: Treat doctor ok as proof all chats were remembered or pending lessons worked.
scenarios.observed: Simulated instruction walkthrough keeps diagnostics success separate from capture coverage, semantic recall, authenticated review and lesson efficacy.

similar_skills.learned: Search compact records first and load exact evidence only for selected IDs.
similar_skills.reason: Retain bounded briefs and paged evidence. Add a read-only readiness report exposing staleness and pending outcomes instead of making capture completeness claims.

similar_skills.learned: The Codex remember skill relies on background extraction after a session and warns against inventing a stored memory ID.
similar_skills.reason: Keep explicit capture receipts and project-local source checks; do not claim background extraction, install a daemon or require cloud/model credentials. The no-fabricated-receipt principle is retained.

validation.command: cd work-memory && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_*.py
